rule_title: TTP 1562.001 / 1562.002 - Defense Evasion: Audit Policy Tampering or Defender Exclusion Added
description: Detects two high-fidelity defense evasion behaviours: (a) disabling or clearing Windows audit subcategories via auditpol.exe, and (b) adding Microsoft Defender exclusions for paths, processes, or extensions via Add-MpPreference / Set-MpPreference, or disabling Defender real-time protection features. Either action on a production endpoint is almost always an attacker preparing to execute payloads or cover their tracks. Requires PowerShell Script Block Logging (EID 4104) enabled.
